prompt:
为 Godot 游戏生成一个可直接使用的button图片资源。
资源功能：Battle action botanical specimen card framing existing live plant illustration, name and cost。
用途：Battle action botanical specimen card framing existing live plant illustration, name and cost。
游戏内实际显示尺寸：142x110 像素。
内容安全区：左 20px、上 16px、右 20px、下 16px。
项目风格：Project greenhouse botanical storybook UI, as specified by ordered per-resource contracts.。
视觉锚点：Approved botanical greenhouse: hand-painted ink-green glass with blue-grey shaded edges; narrow worn brass double rim; sparse flattened leaf embossing at corners; soft upper-left light; warm pale text; clean quiet readout centers. References res://Design/Sunflower-Defense-Art-Style-Guide.md, res://assets/ui/generated/battle_hud_v3/primary_action_normal.png and res://assets/ui/generated/battle_hud_v3/tactical_bezel.png.。
1. Game asset use: Battle action botanical specimen card framing existing live plant illustration, name and cost.
2. Runtime display size and safe area: source [512, 512], runtime [142, 110]; nine-slice only straight edges and quiet center, corners uniformly scale; transparent outer margin 8px; 20px runtime text and input safe margins.
3. Project visual anchor: Approved botanical greenhouse: hand-painted ink-green glass with blue-grey shaded edges; narrow worn brass double rim; sparse flattened leaf embossing at corners; soft upper-left light; warm pale text; clean quiet readout centers. References res://Design/Sunflower-Defense-Art-Style-Guide.md, res://assets/ui/generated/battle_hud_v3/primary_action_normal.png and res://assets/ui/generated/battle_hud_v3/tactical_bezel.png.
4. Composition and state contract: Single compact nearly square specimen-window card. Narrow copper-brass rim with small upper corner leaf clasps. Quiet upper illustration window and lower dark green record-label region, no actual separator words. No portraits, plants, icons or costs; runtime supplies them. Empty center with restrained grain. Orthographic view, upper-left soft light. Single neutral master; card states preserve exact alpha geometry through deterministic tint.
5. Comfort constraints: low contrast center, sparse edge texture, no bloom, motion or flashing; subtle material readable at declared runtime size.
6. Project and AI exclusions: no neon, plastic, photography, pixel art, dense ornament, bright glow, text, watermark, logo, unintended objects, baked UI, alternatives or contact sheet.
7. Transparent output: real RGBA exterior and clean alpha; no solid backdrop, checkerboard or environment; glass inset may be translucent.。
布局：Single compact nearly square specimen-window card. Narrow copper-brass rim with small upper corner leaf clasps. Quiet upper illustration window and lower dark green record-label region, no actual separator words. No portraits, plants, icons or costs; runtime supplies them. Empty center with restrained grain.。
状态一致性：Neutral master; all card states share exact alpha。
舒适度约束：Low contrast centers; restrained warm highlights without bloom；Sparse edge engraving; no flashing or motion implied；Clear silhouettes at 160 and 176 pixels; quiet runtime text areas。
不得生成：pixel art、photography、candy saturation、neon、chrome、plastic、dense decoration、baked UI、text、watermark、logo、flowers、portraits、busy center。
禁止任何可读或伪造的文字、字母、数字、签名和水印；文字由 Godot 字体系统绘制。
输出为真实透明 PNG；禁止棋盘格、白底、纯色背景和背景底板。
